name: UpdateNotificationTemplate
description: Updates an existing notification template. The tokenized fields are validated before the changes are persisted.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api` with functionality `NotificationTemplates:Edit`

headers.name: EVA-User-Agent
headers.description: The user agent that is making these calls. Don't make this specific per device/browser but per application. This should be of the form: `MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0`

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnitID
headers.description: The ID of the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnit-Query
headers.description: The query that selects the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-Mode
headers.description: The IDs mode to run this request in. Currently only `ExternalIDs` is supported.

B.name: DataPayload
B.description:
The data payload template, rendered alongside the notification. It has to render into a JSON object of text values. The values it renders are added to the ones the server always fills in itself (`NotificationKey`, `NotificationID`, `SourceType`, `SourceID` and the identifiers of what the notification is about) and cannot override them.

Providing a `null` value and not providing the property at all has different meanings.

B.name: Description
B.description:
The description body of the notification.

Providing a `null` value and not providing the property at all has different meanings.

B.name: ID
B.description:
The ID of the notification template to update.

This is the ID of a `NotificationTemplate`

B.name: IsDisabled
B.description: Whether this template is disabled and should not be used for rendering.

B.name: LanguageID
B.description:
The language this template is rendered in.

This is the ID of a `Language`

While this property is not required, if it is sent in the request it must have a valid value.

B.name: NotificationType
B.description:
The type of notification this template renders.
Possible values:

* `0` - Alert
* `1` - Actionable
* `2` - Silent
* `3` - LiveActivity

B.name: OrganizationUnitID
B.description:
The organization unit this template applies to. Leave empty for a template that applies to every organization unit.

This is the ID of a `OrganizationUnit`

Providing a `null` value and not providing the property at all has different meanings.

B.name: ScriptID
B.description:
The script that decides whether this notification is sent, and that may replace its title, subtitle and description. It has to be an active Notification extension point script.

This is the ID of a `Script`

Providing a `null` value and not providing the property at all has different meanings.

B.name: Subtitle
B.description:
The subtitle of the notification.

Providing a `null` value and not providing the property at all has different meanings.

B.name: TemplateKey
B.description:
The key that identifies which notification this template renders.

While this property is not required, if it is sent in the request it must have a valid value.

Possible values:

* `UserTaskUrgent`
* `UserTaskCreated`
* `FullStockCountStarted`
* `UserTaskUnassigned`
* `AppointmentReminder`
* `AppointmentCancelled`

B.name: Title
B.description:
The title of the notification.

While this property is not required, if it is sent in the request it must have a valid value.

D.name: Code
D.description: A unique ID identifying this error.

D.name: Message
D.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

D.name: RequestID
D.description: A unique ID identifying the request. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

D.name: Type
D.description: A short description of the error type.

E.name: ExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the resolved external IDs.

E.name: IsAsyncResultAvailable
E.description: This is a flag indicating whether the async request is done. If it is `null`, it is not an async service. If it is `false`, the response is not yet available. Do not process the properties in that case. It is is `true` the properties are filled with the result of the call.

E.name: UnresolvedExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the external IDs we couldn't resolve.
